## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#101.

This adds a noise-only profile workflow for microphone/background noise reduction. Users can load a short audio file containing only hiss, hum, fan noise, or room tone; the library analyzes that file into a compact spectral profile and applies bounded multiband attenuation before the existing enhancement chain.

## Implementation

- Added `AudioAnalyzer.createNoiseProfileFromSamples()` and `AudioAnalyzer.createNoiseProfileFromAudioBuffer()`.
- Added `AudioNoiseProfile`, `AudioNoiseProfileBand`, `AudioNoiseProfileOptions`, `noiseProfile`, and `noiseProfileReduction` API types/options.
- Added a profile reduction stage before the existing noise gate, smart normalization, and saturation processing.
- Added example-app controls to load, persist, tune, and clear a noise profile.
- Added case-study research and issue metadata under `docs/case-studies/issue-101`.
- Updated README usage documentation.

## Reproduction / Verification

The previous `noiseReduction` control used only generic quiet-signal attenuation and a high-pass filter, so it could not learn microphone-specific hiss or hum. The new tests synthesize noise-only samples, build a profile, verify stronger reduction for the dominant noisy band, and verify active graph rebuilding/clearing behavior.

Local checks run:

- `npm run lint`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm test -- --runInBand` (322 tests)
- `npm run build`
- Browser verification via Playwright MCP: loaded `examples/`, generated a WAV noise profile in-browser, confirmed `Noise profile loaded`, 12 profile bands, enabled controls, and clear-profile behavior.

Build still prints the repo's existing Rollup/package module-type and TS5069 warnings, but exits successfully.

## Screenshot

![Noise profile controls](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-101-3efb01d67058/docs/case-studies/issue-101/noise-profile-section.png?raw=true)
